responsibility: Implements loop invariant motion and store motion on tree SSA loops. It analyzes statements and memory references to determine the outermost loop where computations are invariant, tracks dependence and always-executed information, builds per-loop memory-access summaries for load/store legality, hoists sufficiently profitable invariant computations to preheaders, optionally performs loop store motion, and repairs loop-closed SSA after the inserted and moved code.
